# Tunneling_Based_Connectivity

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A network method (e.g., UU remote) that establishes secure, low-latency links between local and remote agents, bypassing NAT or firewall restrictions. Provides reliable communication channels for TCC/iNEST systems, enabling remote control and data flow in constrained network environments.
